metadata.library_profile: normal --release, no optional features, one worker
metadata.baseline_scope: Baseline includes earlier borrowed-trigram and unsampled-table-preparation changes; apply baseline_patch to starting_revision to reconstruct. Initial and retained patches apply on that baseline. Tests in patches do not affect release library builds.
limitations: Shared-host scheduling causes variation; all measured controls and adverse results are retained.
VmHWM is process-lifetime peak including loading and startup; no consistent memory reduction claimed.
The pinned retained COMA multiword-overlap control regressed 13.3%; the short/unequal Levenshtein microcontrols also regressed.
Both COMA batches verify full ordered score and component-detail bits across versions/repetitions. Jaccard uses the existing native runner fingerprint including selections.

COMA initial candidate changed negative-zero behavior for empty source vectors during testing; it was corrected before any COMA timings. Retained code leaves zero-vocabulary inputs on the original loop.

coma.reproduction_notes: The measured temporary harness boxed the matcher and selected coma_instances by its final argument. Its exact source and original runner are retained. The committed coma_trigrams_bench.rs dataset_instances mode supplies the same tables/configuration/get_matches operation; reproduction runners below adapt the arguments. Compile the measured_harness_source instead to reproduce the exact original harness. All construction and configuration is outside timing.

levenshtein_micro.method: Five alternating batches per implementation in one process, one warmup before each timing; compiled rustc --edition2024 -C opt-level=3 against existing strsim0.11.1 and rapidfuzz0.5.0 artifacts. Scalar function microbenchmark, not a full matcher.

metadata.method: Five fresh processes per case and version, alternate before/after order each round, one warmup and five timed direct get_matches calls per process. Compare exact IEEE-754 score bits and correspondence pairs across every report. Existing runner rejects changed outputs between iterations. No concurrent repository CPU work; CPU affinity not pinned. Loading and startup excluded from matching_seconds; all process reports retained.
